name: nisum-mfe-final-project
description: Final MFE training project - E-commerce platform built with Module Federation, npm workspaces, Redux Toolkit and a NISUM window event bus

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,product,cart,orders,gateway -c yellow,blue,green,magenta,cyan "npm run dev --workspace=api" "npm run dev --workspace=mfe-product" "npm run dev --workspace=mfe-cart" "npm run dev --workspace=mfe-orders" "npm run dev --workspace=gateway"
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
